line: LANE-CURVES Phase 1: per-side empirical FV-to-outcome curves + industry bake-off

schema.curves.<side>.war: E[first-6yr total bWAR | consensus FV], per side. Parallel per-knot lists: knots, isotonic (raw weighted-PAVA fit), prior (Clemens 2026 per side x span factor), n_cell (rows within +/-1.25 FV of the knot), w_prior (K/(K+n_cell), K=30), shrunk (blend), value (SHIPPABLE curve: shrunk, re-PAVA'd, strict +0.01 WAR per knot step), ci90_lo/hi (player-clustered bootstrap, refit each draw), extrapolation (knot below the data floor).
schema.curves.<side>.p_bust: P(first-6yr total bWAR < 1.0 | FV), monotone decreasing.
schema.curves.<side>.p_star: P(first-6yr total bWAR >= 10.0 | FV), monotone increasing.
schema.curves.<side>.p_bust_bucket: P(< 3.0) = value_framework bust band x 6 seasons.
schema.curves.<side>.p_star_bucket: P(>= 24.0) = value_framework star band x 6 seasons.
schema.curves.<side>.outcome_buckets: empirical 5-bin distribution per knot cell (bands = value_framework per-season bands x 6). NOT shrunk, NOT monotonized; `measured` is n>=30.
schema.sensitivity.<side>.war_censored_included: the same curve fit on ALL rows including censored, on target_censored, weighted by observed_seasons/6 (the production fit weighting).
schema.bakeoff.<candidate>.<raw|shape>.<side>: held-out metrics pooled over forward-chained folds. `bands` keyed by FV band; each cell has n, slope + intercept (OLS of realized on implied), bias_mean_resid (mean realized - implied), mae, mean_implied, mean_realized. coverage_90 = share of (fold x band) cells with >=10 held-out rows whose bootstrap CI90 for the realized cell mean contains the candidate's implied cell mean.
schema.conversions: every unit conversion applied to every published table.
schema.phase2_inputs: REPORT ONLY. Counterfactual re-scaled grades for the ten named players, the implied top-N board side mix, and the within-side monotonicity confirmation. Nothing served moves.

pool.y: realized_war_6yr (== matrix target_censored, the label efv_score scores)

method.monotone_fit: weighted PAVA isotonic, linear interpolation between block centroids

shrinkage.prior: Clemens 2026 per-side expected WAR (Quantity B), interpolated
shrinkage.why_this_prior: the only published PER-SIDE table measuring the same quantity as our label: bust-inclusive mean total control-window WAR with the zeros left in

strict_monotone.why: Phase 2 inverts the curve; a PAVA plateau makes the inverse a set rather than a value

bootstrap.clustered_by: player_key (== row at this grain, asserted)

thresholds.provenance: primary thresholds borrow Edwards 2019 THRESHOLD VALUES (<1.0 bust, >10 star); his quantity is 9-season arb-discounted present-day WAR and ours is an undiscounted 6-season total, so the value is borrowed and the quantity is NOT

mcdaniel_2014.source_quantity: WAR per SEASON, true talent (S3 2014 / L10 2015 read as peak)
mcdaniel_2014.notes: no published 20/25 row (McDaniel says so explicitly); held flat at the FV30 value of -1.0. The negative low end is NOT clipped.

primer_bands.source_quantity: average annual WAR over the first six SERVICE years (S2 2018 / L7 2022)
primer_bands.notes: the pitcher table is a STARTER table applied to ALL pitchers including reliever-outcome rows: a disclosed mismatch, not corrected. L7 publishes 35/35+ = '<-0.1' for pitchers but no 35 row for hitters, so pit35 = -0.1 while hit35 is interpolated to 0.125.

clemens_2026.source_quantity: TOTAL undiscounted WAR over the whole team-control span (L1 2026)
clemens_2026.notes: Clemens' span is '6 to 7-plus years' of control; our label is 6 calendar seasons from debut. Primary factor 1.000 on the argument that both are 'everything the club got from the prospect'. '+' tiers placed at the half-step (35+ -> 37.5, 40+ -> 42.5, 45+ -> 47.5). No 75/80 row: held flat at 70.

shipped_fv_to_6yr_avg_war.source_quantity: expected (bust-inclusive) average annual WAR over 6 years
shipped_fv_to_6yr_avg_war.notes: read live from the PRODUCTION valuation set (clemens_2026, the bare-import default) with anchor_calibration.use_empirical true, so these are the fitted empirical_anchors including the 2026-07-29 sub-45 amendment, not the config seed.

shipped_expected_war_core.source_quantity: the exact forward map realized_implied_fv inverts to make xfv_grade
shipped_expected_war_core.conversion: vf.expected_war(FV, is_pitcher, position, service_years=6, age=_grade_map_age(debut_age))['mean'], per row
shipped_expected_war_core.notes: DIAGNOSTIC, not one of the six. Phase 2 replaces THIS, not the x6 table.

shipped_prime_via_aging.conversion: sum(vf.prospect_prime_path(FV, is_pitcher, debut_age)['mean'][:6]) -- the prime path run through the shipped aging curve and summed over the six-season window, per row with the row's own debut age
shipped_prime_via_aging.notes: fv_to_prime_war is used in code as the P(bucket|FV)-weighted per-season LEVEL under the prime scale (_prime_war_scale sets the bucket scale so the weighted mean equals the anchor), so it is bust-inclusive but on a talent LEVEL roughly 1.85x the realized anchor.

empirical_perside.conversion: none; fit on the TRAIN fold only, per fold

empirical_pooled.conversion: none. DIAGNOSTIC: the comparator for the per-side claim

empirical_sidepermuted.source_quantity: our label, side labels shuffled in TRAIN

head_to_head_note: paired player-clustered bootstrap on the HELD-OUT rows. Negative delta = the FIRST candidate is better. Keys are mode|side|A_vs_B. delta_mae is compared against the gate standard's MAE MDE95 (0.20 hit / 0.06 pit): a delta inside that band is a NULL, not a win.

C1_zero_information_control.criterion: if the side-label-permuted curve matches per-side on held-out MAE within the fold spread, the side split carries no information
C1_zero_information_control.verdict: MAE ARM FIRES (both sides inside the MAE MDE95, i.e. MAE cannot separate the real split from the permuted one); SLOPE ARM DOES NOT (per-side is closer to slope 1 than the control on both sides)

C2_pooled_comparator.criterion: reject if per-side does not beat the pooled curve on held-out MAE on BOTH sides

C3_industry_table_wins_at_fv50plus.criterion: reject if any industry table beats the per-side curve on BOTH slope and MAE in the FV >= 50 band on BOTH sides

C4_top_band_measurable.criterion: if pooled cell n at FV >= 60 is under 15 per side, the 60+ knots are prior-dominated and Phase 2 must read the prior there

C5_monotone_repair.criterion: reject if the strictly-increasing enforcement moves any knot by > 0.5 WAR

C6_grade_movement.criterion: flag for owner call if any named player moves > 10 FV or the top-100 pitcher share passes 40

deviations_from_pre_registration.pre_registered: PAVA over the knot values with UNIT weights
deviations_from_pre_registration.shipped: PAVA over the knot values weighted by n_cell + K, taking the direct projection at each knot instead of re-interpolating between block centroids
deviations_from_pre_registration.why: the unit-weight, centroid-interpolated version let three ZERO-DATA knots (FV 20/25/30) pool 1:1 with the measured FV35 and FV37.5 knots and inflate the measured hit FV35 value 12x (0.024 -> 0.295 total 6yr WAR), and the centroid shift dragged the hit FV70 knot 5.25 WAR off its shrunk value. That is a defect in the rule, not a finding in the data.

deviations_from_pre_registration.item: prior extension below the table's bottom row
deviations_from_pre_registration.pre_registered: Clemens prior 'linearly interpolated in FV' (implicitly clamped)
deviations_from_pre_registration.shipped: linear ramp from the bottom published row (35+, placed at 37.5) down to 0.0 at FV 20
deviations_from_pre_registration.why: clamping put the prior (0.30 hit / 0.25 pit) ABOVE the measured value at FV35 (0.07 / 0.01) at w_prior = 1.0, so a prior with no data behind it was pulling measured knots upward

deviations_from_pre_registration.pre_registered: the isotonic fit evaluated AT the knot
deviations_from_pre_registration.shipped: the mean of the isotonic FITTED values over the rows in the knot cell
deviations_from_pre_registration.why: evaluating at the knot reads whichever exact-FV tie group sits there (hit FV35.0 alone is 165 rows at mean -0.004) while the shrinkage weight reads the +/-1.25 cell (332 rows, mean +0.072); the estimate and its own sample size disagreed. Both readings are reported per knot (isotonic, cell_mean).

deviations_from_pre_registration.pre_registered: a monotone ramp under the fitted FV35 value
deviations_from_pre_registration.shipped: the production concave re-spread (value_framework._LOWEND_FG_EXP = 0.45, inverted) anchored on the fitted FV35 value; the prior-ramp variant is retained per knot as value_sub_floor_prior_ramp_variant
deviations_from_pre_registration.why: Phase 2 has to decide whether to keep the FV 20-45 display re-spread. The measured curve is flat there (hit 0.10 -> 0.47 over FV 35 -> 40), so the outcome basis cannot generate that granularity and the policy has to be declared rather than fitted.

deviations_from_pre_registration.pre_registered: per-candidate slope / bias / MAE / coverage only
deviations_from_pre_registration.shipped: added a paired, player-clustered bootstrap on the held-out rows with a per-fold sign count, for each contest a reject criterion is written on
deviations_from_pre_registration.why: criteria 1-3 are comparative and a table of separate point estimates cannot adjudicate them; the gate standard requires a paired bootstrap with a control and >= 4 time splits

phase2_inputs.pooled_curve_note: a side-NEUTRAL outcome curve reproduces the current joint ordering (both are monotone maps of predicted WAR), so the entire cross-side change is attributable to the side split and to nothing else in this lane
phase2_inputs.low_end_note: board rows whose predicted WAR6 sits below the curve value at the DATA FLOOR (consensus FV 35) cannot be graded by OUTCOME: the measured curve is nearly flat from 35 to 40 (hit 0.10 -> 0.47, pit 0.05 -> 0.40 total 6yr WAR), so the outcome basis carries no FV 20-45 display granularity of its own. Phase 2 must therefore keep the production concave re-spread below the floor, which is what sub_floor_mode='concave_policy' reproduces. clamped_at_20 counts rows whose predicted WAR6 is <= 0 and so read exactly 20.0; compare board_rows_already_at_grade_20_served, which is the same count under the SERVED map (the shipped map floors at 20 for war <= 0 too), so this is not a change the re-scale introduces.
